messages:
Aisha: Quick check — post-summit wrap for Summit NY 2026. We have 1.2k booth scans, ~230 badge drops, and a crate of leftover hoodies/stickers. Need: 1) lead routing to SDRs + campaign tags, 2) confirm swag return / donate plan, 3) quick post-event social post schedule. Who can own each?
Ben: I can own lead routing. Planning to split by intent score > 70 -> Diego SDR team (high-touch), 40-70 -> nurture emails, <40 -> newsletter. Will export CSV tonight.
Clara: thx Ben. For campaign tags use utm_campaign=summit_nyc_2026 and set lead_source=booth. Can you add model-interest column? we captured model prefs on the form.
Ben: yep — will map as: form_model -> model_interest. here's the export cmd I ran: 
```
/export leads --event summit-nyc-2026 --fields name,email,intent_score,form_model,notes --format csv
```
Diego: +1. For high-touch leads, please add tag "enterprise" if company_size>500 or notes contain "security/SLA". I'll queue them in SFDC queue "NYC-Summit-Hot".
Eli: Swag update — 48 hoodies, 400 stickers, 2 demo kits to return. Courier booked for Mon 10AM to HQ returns dock. Return label numbers: RBX-73219, RBX-73220. If we donate, I can coordinate pickup to DataKind NYC on Tue.
Clara: Donate seems better for extras. Hoodies to donate, stickers to keep for next month meetups?
Aisha: Decision: Hoodies -> donate (Clara + Eli), Stickers -> inventory (Marketing ops). Ben to export & handoff leads to Diego by EOD. Diego to tag enterprise leads and confirm queue. Eli to confirm courier and send tracking to #logistics.
Diego: I'll prioritize top 40 leads; share CRM list in the thread when queued.
swag-bot: Inventory updated: -48 hoodies, -400 stickers. New stock: stickers=1200, hoodies=82.
Aisha: Tiny ask — can someone draft a short post-event post for LinkedIn + twitter? 2 lines + 1 stat. I'll post.
Clara: I'll draft. Proposed: "Thanks NYC devs — 1,200 chats at our booth, 230 demos, 3 major enterprise conversations. DM us for early access to Redwood Dedicated."
Ben: looks good.
Aisha: Action items recap (assign): Ben=lead export+mapping, Diego=queue & prioritize, Eli=courier & tracking, Clara=post draft + donation coord, Aisha=publish + follow-ups. Check boxes when done. :white_check_mark:
